entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH  CRIMINAL PETITION No. 3821 of 2020 O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.109/2019 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kurnool IV Town Police Station, Kurnool against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 273 r/w34 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Kurnool IV Town Police Station, Kurnool
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent -State.
At the time of hearing, both the counsel gave consent to dispose of the matter at the stage of admission.
Learned counsel for petitioners submits that the subject matter of the criminal petition is squarely covered by the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not refute the said submission.

Considering the submissions and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the proceedings in FIR No.109/2019 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kurnool IV Town Police Station, Kurnool against the petitioners are hereby quashed in terms of the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.

entities.text: Kurnool IV Town Police Station, Kurnool
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: With the above observations, the criminal petition is allowed at the stage of admission.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH 11th September, 2020 Mjl/*
